categories.title_zh: 🌟 综合研究智能体与技能
🔎 深度研究与自动综述生成
🧪 自主科研：从想法到论文
🗂️ 文献管理与 Zotero / Obsidian 集成
🕸️ 引文图谱与 API 客户端
✍️ 论文写作与同行评审助手

tools.name: academic-research-skills
tools.description_en: **The most popular project in this space.** A suite of Claude Code skills running a 10-stage pipeline (research→write→review→revise→finalize) with citation/claim "integrity gates," cross-checked against Semantic Scholar + OpenAlex + Crossref. Philosophy: *"AI is your copilot, not the pilot."* `/plugin install academic-research-skills`
tools.description_zh: **本领域最受欢迎的项目。** 一套 Claude Code 技能，10 阶段流水线（研究→写作→评审→修订→定稿），内置引用/论断「诚信门」，跨 Semantic Scholar + OpenAlex + Crossref 三源校验。理念：*「AI 是副驾，不是主驾」*。`/plugin install academic-research-skills`

tools.name: academic-research-skills-codex
tools.description_en: Codex-native sibling of the above, human-in-the-loop research flow
tools.description_zh: 上者的 Codex 原生版，人在环中的学术研究流程

tools.name: Research-Paper-Writing-Skills
tools.description_en: ML/CV/NLP paper-writing skill pack; works with Codex, Claude Code, and Gemini
tools.description_zh: ML/CV/NLP 论文写作技能包（改编自彭思达老师笔记），兼容 Codex / Claude Code / Gemini

tools.name: claude-skills
tools.description_en: Large skill collection incl. a litreview / grants / deep-research stack across Claude Code / Codex / Gemini / Cursor
tools.description_zh: 大型技能合集，内含 litreview / grants / deep-research 研究栈，跨 Claude Code / Codex / Gemini / Cursor

tools.name: academic-paper-skills
tools.description_en: Strategist (planning) + Composer (writing) skills with quality checkpoints
tools.description_zh: Strategist（规划）+ Composer（写作）双技能，带质量检查点

tools.name: dr-claw
tools.description_en: A "research IDE" with multiple AI-assistant personas
tools.description_zh: 「科研 IDE」，内置多个 AI 助手角色

tools.name: ScienceClaw
tools.description_en: Self-evolving AI research colleague, 285 skills, "zero hallucination" claim
tools.description_zh: 自进化的 AI 科研伙伴，285 个技能，主打「零幻觉」

tools.name: qinyan-academic-skills
tools.description_en: Multilingual library of 182 installable AI-agent skills across disciplines
tools.description_zh: 多语言的 182 个可安装 AI 智能体技能库，覆盖多学科

tools.name: agent-research-skills
tools.description_en: Claude Code skills for systematic literature review, incl. citation-validation scripts
tools.description_zh: 面向系统性文献综述的 Claude Code 技能，含引用校验脚本

tools.name: medsci-skills
tools.description_en: Medical-research skills: search, reporting-guideline/citation checks, stats, figures, submission (by a physician-researcher)
tools.description_zh: 医学科研技能：检索、报告规范/引用核查、统计、出版图表、投稿（医生-研究者出品）

tools.name: STORM
tools.description_en: Stanford OVAL; retrieval-grounded "pre-writing + writing" stages, produces Wikipedia-style long articles with citations; includes conversational Co-STORM
tools.description_zh: 斯坦福 OVAL 出品，基于检索的「预写作 + 写作」两阶段，生成维基百科式长文并附引用；含多智能体对话式版本 Co-STORM

tools.name: gpt-researcher
tools.description_en: Autonomous agent that runs deep research on any topic and outputs a cited report; general-purpose, not academic-only
tools.description_zh: 自主研究智能体，对任意主题做深度调研并生成带引用报告；通用型，非学术专用

tools.name: deep-research
tools.description_en: Minimal iterative deep-research agent (search + scrape + LLM refinement); small and hackable
tools.description_zh: 极简的迭代式深度研究智能体（搜索 + 抓取 + LLM 精炼），代码短小易改

tools.name: open_deep_research
tools.description_en: LangChain's official open deep-research reference implementation
tools.description_zh: LangChain 官方的开源深度研究参考实现

tools.name: local-deep-research
tools.description_en: Local/private deep-research; 10+ sources incl. arXiv & PubMed, fully local LLMs
tools.description_zh: 本地/隐私优先的深度研究，10+ 数据源含 arXiv / PubMed，可全本地 LLM

tools.name: open-deep-research

tools.description_zh: 基于 Firecrawl 对网页数据推理的开源 deep-research 复刻

tools.name: SurveyX

tools.name: opendraft

tools.name: AI-Scientist
tools.description_en: Sakana AI; end-to-end automated discovery (lit review→experiments→writing→review); see also [v2](https://github.com/SakanaAI/AI-Scientist-v2) (~6.9k, agentic tree search, workshop-level)

tools.name: AI-Scientist-v2
tools.description_en: Workshop-level automated scientific discovery via agentic tree search.

tools.name: AutoResearchClaw
tools.description_en: Self-evolving autonomous research: idea → conference-ready LaTeX paper (real lit from OpenAlex/S2/arXiv + sandboxed experiments + multi-agent peer review)
tools.description_zh: 自进化的自主科研：从想法到可投稿 LaTeX 论文（OpenAlex/S2/arXiv 真实文献 + 沙盒实验 + 多智能体评审）

tools.name: Agent-Laboratory
tools.description_en: End-to-end autonomous workflow: literature review → experimentation → report writing

tools.name: Zochi

tools.name: DeepInnovator

tools.name: paper-qa

tools.name: prismAId
